text:
maria: Quick Q — planning a cross-SKU sweep (A100 / H100 / L40S) for seqlen=2048, batch=8. Primary goal: detect a ~5% regression in p99 latency between SKUs. How many independent runs per SKU should we schedule? Any recent variance numbers we can reuse as priors?
tj: I usually target 30 runs per config as a baseline. But variance matters — last stable runs showed p99 stdev ~2-3% on dedicated racks.
oliver: Rough power calc: n ≈ ((Z_alpha + Z_beta) * sigma / delta)^2. If sigma=0.02 (2%) and delta=0.05 (5%), then ((1.96+0.84)*0.02/0.05)^2 ≈ 20. So 20-ish if assumptions hold. But p99 is heavy-tailed so add buffer.
sachi: +1 to interleaving across hosts to avoid temporal drift. We should warm KV/cache for a few runs then sample. I pulled variance from the last week: A100 p99 mean 118ms stdev 3.5ms, H100 mean 112ms stdev 2.8ms, L40S mean 125ms stdev 4.0ms. I'll attach a tiny CSV below.
perf-bot: auto: recent-sweep-summary.csv -> a100_p99_mean, a100_p99_std, h100_p99_mean, h100_p99_std, l40s_p99_mean, l40s_p99_std = 118,3.5,112,2.8,125,4.0
maria: Thanks — variance numbers helpful. Given heavy tails and potential infra noise, I'm leaning to 40 runs per SKU to be conservative and allow bootstrap CIs. Plan: 5 warm runs, then 40 measured runs, interleaved machine-wise. @tj can you add a run tag (sku-sweep-176888) and ensure raw per-request latencies + KV_hit flag are captured? Also include machine id in outputs so we can stratify by host.
tj: Yep. I'll update bench CI matrix and add telemetry fields. Will also set up the run to shuffle host assignment each iteration to avoid contiguous bias.
oliver: I'll add bootstrap p99 CI to the analysis notebook and compute the minimum detectable effect for our observed sigma. If we still want formal power=0.8 at alpha=0.05, we can compute exact n and compare to 40.
sachi: Command we use for the overnight sweep (copy this into bench CI job):
```
./run_sweep.sh --model rlhf-encoder --seqlen 2048 --batch 8 \ 
  --warmup-runs 5 --measured-runs 40 --shuffle-hosts true \ 
  --emit-fields latency_ms,p99,kv_hit,machine_id \ 
  --run-tag sku-sweep-176888
```
maria: Perfect. I'll kick it off tonight and share raw CSV + notebook link when done. If anyone has objections to 40 runs speak now, otherwise proceed. :thumbsup:
tj: no objections from infra side.
oliver: SGTM, will add the power calc cell.
sachi: I'll monitor for flaky machines and drop any hosts with >5% failure rate before analysis.
maria: Great, thanks all — will post results in the morning.
